plugins.name: zeeg
plugins.description: Work with your Zeeg scheduling, CRM and AI phone agents from Claude: book and move meetings, keep CRM records clean, and review voice agent calls. Connects to the Zeeg MCP server, hosted in Germany.

skills.name: agent-tuning
skills.description: Review a Zeeg AI phone agent's calls through the Zeeg MCP tools and suggest concrete improvements to its prompt, questions and routing. Use when the user asks how their voice agent is doing, why calls fail or end early, what callers ask for, or how to improve the agent.
headings: Tuning a Zeeg AI phone agent
skills.description_zh: 通过Zeeg MCP评审AI电话代理通话，为提示词、问题和路由提出具体改进，分析失败、提前结束及来电者需求。

skills.name: booking-operations
skills.description: Book, reschedule, cancel or hand over Zeeg meetings, mark no-shows, and find open times, through the Zeeg MCP tools. Use when the user asks to schedule someone, find a slot, move or cancel a booking, see what is booked, hand a meeting to a colleague, or record that an invitee did not turn up.
skills.description_zh: 通过Zeeg MCP预约、改期、取消或移交会议，标记未到场并查找空闲时段和既有安排。

skills.name: crm-hygiene
skills.description: Keep the Zeeg CRM clean through the Zeeg MCP tools - find duplicate or incomplete people and companies, fill missing fields from booking and form context, and link people to their companies. Use when the user asks to tidy, dedupe, enrich or update CRM contacts, companies or custom records in Zeeg.
skills.description_zh: 通过Zeeg MCP清理CRM，发现重复或不完整的个人及公司记录，从预约和表单上下文补字段，并关联联系人与公司。
